scope: Current AppShell package: actual pacman fresh installation in a new isolated root, 0.1.1 to 0.1.2 upgrade in the historical isolated root/database, then ordinary-user execution on the real host Wayland session. Restored copy of a historical populated SQLite workspace was opened by the upgraded application. Not a system-global install, clean-OS VM, release publication or production migration drill.
package_signature_policy: Required DatabaseOptional; LocalFileSigLevel Optional, matching historical offline config. No repository/network access in pacman installation. Local packages are unsigned, not release-trust evidence.

arch_build.note: Documented scripts/build_desktop_arch.sh --build is hardcoded to 0.1.0; ran it unchanged successfully. Next-version 0.1.2 recipe was generated from the current tracked PKGBUILD using the historical upgrade-recipe method, under this drill log directory. umask 022; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1789257600; PATH=/tmp/nodeshim:$PATH. No tracked packaging scripts were changed.

shutdown.runtime_stop: explicit SIGTERM to own runtime after native confirmation automation limitation

sqlite_backup_method.method: SQLite online Connection.backup from mode=ro source; restore with the same API, copy blobs separately. Open only the restored copy on current runtime. Compare integrity, row counts, and complete canonical row SHA256 for core tables; historical source data unchanged.

pacman_file_verification.namespace: unshare --user --map-root-user; mapped namespace root, not host root

failures.root_cause: Package metadata stores UID/GID 0; namespace maps them to host UID/GID 1000. Host-side checks report ownership differences, not changed payload. Same check in the installation user namespace reports 1106 files, 0 changed, exit 0 for both roots.
The helper inherited no WAYLAND_DISPLAY. Both attempts exited 1 with Wayland connection failed. Setting WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1 lets text entry connect and succeed.
NIRI_SOCKET was missing in this session. Set it to the existing /run/user/1000/niri.wayland-1.1558.sock for later compositor commands.
The installed helper has no --help mode and requires an input argument; --help and empty argv each exit 1. These were interface probes, not package failures.

failures.step: native chooser and quit key confirmation
failures.root_cause: wtype delivered text but Return/Tab/Alt+O did not activate these native buttons. Exact protocol/key handling cause is unconfirmed. The GTK chooser exposed an AT-SPI button and was successfully confirmed through that real button. Electron quit dialog did not expose an AT-SPI application; only the drill-owned runtime was SIGTERM-stopped, then its Electron closed with exit 0. No other app/process was touched.

OPEN FINDING: after niri msg action close-window --id 25 removed its only visible window, Electron remained sleeping with 36 threads beyond a 15-second wait; CDP page targets were empty. No source/runtime or exit dialog existed. Window-all-closed event emission was not instrumented, so cause is unconfirmed; no fix applied. Captured process tree, /proc state, host log tail, and close path before SIGTERM cleanup of only this drill app.
Probe incorrectly looked for .app-shell; actual AppShell root uses .shell. Fresh installed-package DOM probe confirms .shell and .sources; upgraded shell is confirmed by screenshots.

runtime_warnings.cause: Host cache version 0x2012003 is newer than bundled consumer 0x2012001; cache was not modified. Renderer still displayed the complete AppShell.

runtime_warnings.message: lsfg-vk Failed to initialize global info: Unknown key in configuration: game
runtime_warnings.cause: External host Vulkan layer reports an unsupported configuration key; no layer/system config was modified. No package launch failure observed.

runtime_warnings.message: pacman missing repository database warnings on initial query
runtime_warnings.cause: Initial read-only -Q used default config against the isolated DB, which has only local dependency metadata and no synchronized repositories. Offline config used for transactions avoids repository access.

limitations: Isolated dependency metadata was copied, not dependency installation on a clean OS; host libraries/service session satisfy runtime dependencies.

Normal execution directly invokes the installed /opt/deepdocparse/deepdocparse under the isolated path: /usr/bin launcher intentionally references real /opt and cannot be used without host installation.
No model cache, active task failure recovery, production migration, RPO/RTO, release-signing trust, rollback or publishing claim.
No --no-sandbox or setuid fallback was added; Electron app.enableSandbox remains active. User-namespace root was used only for pacman, never GUI launch.
Fresh-install window-close lingering-process finding remains open, and native quit confirmation key automation did not prove the stop-and-exit path.
The SQLite restore is a copied historical real workspace, not live writes into or modification of previously running apps/workspaces.
